title: Artificial intelligence
description: AI helpers for reminder drafts, natural-language search and invoice scanning. AI features stay off until the key is configured.

status.title: Configuration status
status.vision_off: Image reading is off: set AI_VISION_MODEL to scan invoices.

setup.title: Setup
setup.body: Set the secrets below with wrangler. The key is never shown in the app. AI_PROVIDER is openai-compatible, anthropic or mock; AI_DAILY_LIMIT sets the daily cap (200 by default).
